// P-FLOW-01 GREEN fixture: the same rare inline-PII result body, tagged with the canonical
// multi-line six-tag #[personal_data(...)] form the flow schema uses on its crypto-shred locators
// (result_key_ref / payload_key_ref). The lint must ADMIT it (it is now erasable: erasing a subject
// crypto-shreds the inline-PII result by destroying the named per-subject DEK — §4.8 / ADR-12.3).
pub struct WfHistoryRow {
    pub tenant_id: String,
    pub region: String,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Content,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = TenantPolicy,
        erasure = CryptoShred(subject_dek),
        subject_locator = "message_body",
    )]
    pub message_body: String,
}
